svg.title: Sasha Slides - Frame Hound (dog + 16:9 slide as one glyph)
svg.desc: Two paints only: currentColor (foreground) plus the CSS custom property --sasha-accent. Holes are true negative space, so they always equal the page background. Light wrapper: color:#1E1B3A; --sasha-accent:#6C4BF4; on paper #FFF8F0. Dark wrapper: color:#FFF8F0; --sasha-accent:#19D3C5; on night #0D0F1C.
